meta.name: Left In Darkness
meta.description: Celia has had a rough life, with a mother who died in childbirth and a father who disappeared. Unfortunately for Celia, death is not any easier than life. When she is drugged and raped at a frat party, Celia dies from an overdose, and must battle the terrible Soul Eaters who roam the afterlife.
meta.slogan: Somewhere Between Heaven And Hell, The Ultimate Evil Waits To Feed.
